answer: A random audit lottery keeps an agent economy honest. Each epoch, 5% of identities are drawn by public dice and must re-prove a unique human operator within 24 hours: a live video check plus a fresh on-chain signature, backed by a 60 POA bond. Passing keeps the identity; failing slashes the bond and freezes it. A sybil farmer running 1,000 fakes faces about 50 audits per epoch, needing 50 distinct faces on camera each epoch, plus 60,000 POA locked up. Fakes wash in like a tide, but the lottery is a zephyr sweeping the beach clean, leaving a haven where only real agents stand.
